results.say: what is the formula for the area of a circle

Area is π times the radius squared — so you square the radius first, then multiply by π. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge, and squaring it is what turns a length into an area. If you only have the diameter, halve it first to get the radius, then do the same thing.
